name: mahilasathi
description: NCR-wide women's night travel companion and community safety platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:migrate -w server
scripts.db:status: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:status -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && vitest run
scripts.check:providers: npm run build -w shared && npm run check:providers -w server
scripts.demo:seed: npm run build -w shared && npm run demo:seed -w server
scripts.demo:companion: npm run build -w shared && npm run demo:companion -w server --
scripts.db:backup: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:backup -w server --
scripts.demo:reset: npm run build -w shared && npm run demo:reset -w server
scripts.coverage:assess: npm run build -w shared && npm run coverage:assess -w server
